releases.notes:
Download the jar that matches your Minecraft version, plus Fabric Loader and Fabric API for that version.

### Changes
- **Duplicate guild posts:** per-client outbound dedupe (`RecentOutboundStore`); config migration so missing `relayOwnGuildMessages` defaults to **own** (not relay all)
- **Multi-member setups:** everyone on this release should use `/guildbridge relay own`; old jars with `relay all` still double-post to the same webhook
- **Drop alerts:** dungeon and Kuudra chest loot only (no slayer/pets/fishing/Diana `RARE DROP!`)
- `/guildbridge` status shows mod version

releases.notes:
Download the jar that matches your Minecraft version, plus Fabric Loader and Fabric API for that version.

### Changes
- Default `relay own`: each client posts only its own guild lines (fixes duplicate Discord posts when several members run the mod)
- `/guildbridge relay all|own` for single-bridge vs multi-member setups
- SkyBlock drop alerts as Discord embeds; `/guildbridge drops on|off`
